mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_records (student_id, class_id, attendance_date, status_code, check_type, checked_at, gps_latitude, gps_longitude, beacon_uuid, rssi_value, failure_reason, created_by) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{statusCode}, #{checkType}, #{checkedAt}, #{gpsLatitude}, #{gpsLongitude}, #{beaconUuid}, #{rssiValue}, #{failureReason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: SELECT ar.*, u.name AS student_name, c.class_name AS class_name FROM attendance_records ar LEFT JOIN students s ON ar.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN classes c ON ar.class_id = c.class_id
mapper.select: SELECT beacon_uuid AS beaconUuid, rssi_threshold AS rssiThreshold FROM beacons WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY beacon_id LIMIT 1
